Chronological partitions and historical labels
Feature availability

Primary features: first and second activities, prefix elapsed hours, UTC month, weekday and hour. Only two recorded events contribute. Resources and roles are sensitivity-only until ingestion availability is verified. Final case attributes and future outcomes are excluded. IDs and timestamps are audit metadata.

Observed endpoints do not certify completion. Censoring, source-order timestamp ties, singleton selection and overlap purging limit interpretation. Preprocessing fits only unresolved training rows; later unseen categories use zero indicators.
